DML.SELECT: SELECT role_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", preset as "preset", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.roles WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.roles (role_id, alias, description, preset, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.roles'$'role_id'}, :alias, :description, :preset, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.roles SET alias = :alias, description = :description, preset = :preset, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id = :id
